name: Nachtflohmarkt Cottbus

rhythm.en: On a few Saturday evenings a year

facts: indoors across two exhibition halls, 6,000 m² of selling space
well over 100 dealers, thousands of visitors per market day
the organiser calls it the largest evening flea market in Brandenburg
the halls are kept, heated and well lit
entry 4 EUR, children up to 14 free
new goods and clearance stock are not allowed
large free car park directly behind the hall
run together with CMT Cottbus, the exhibition company
notes: The organiser publishes one date only, 7 November 2026; nothing else falls in this window and no 2027 dates are up. The market came back in November 2025 and the organiser calls 7 November its third edition, so the rhythm is a couple of Saturdays a year rather than monthly. Same organiser as the Magdeburg and Rostock night markets already in intake. Coordinates from Nominatim for the Messe Cottbus hall.

description.de: An einzelnen Samstagabenden von 15 bis 22 Uhr in zwei Messehallen, 6.000 Quadratmeter, geheizt und hell. Weit über 100 Händler; der Veranstalter nennt ihn den größten Abendflohmarkt Brandenburgs. Neuware und Restposten sind nicht zugelassen. Eintritt 4 Euro, Kinder bis 14 frei, großer kostenloser Parkplatz hinter der Halle.
description.en: On single Saturday evenings from 3 to 10 at night across two exhibition halls, 6,000 square metres, heated and well lit. Well over 100 dealers; the organiser calls it the largest evening flea market in Brandenburg. New goods and clearance stock are not allowed. Entry 4 euros, under-14s free, with a large free car park behind the hall.
